tagline.zh: 用几何色块复刻即将出现的内容布局,叠加一道扫光脉动表示「加载中」;内容就绪后快速淡入覆盖,布局零跳动。
tagline.en: Geometric placeholder blocks replicate the upcoming content layout, topped by a sweeping shimmer pulse meaning "loading"; content fades in fast once ready, with zero layout shift.

origin.zh: Luke Wroblewski《Avoid The Spinner》确立了骨架屏对 spinner 的替代(注意力落在「内容正在到来」);M3 把 skeleton loaders 列为六大转场模式之一:微妙脉动(视觉走向左上→右下)+ 完成后快速淡入(调研 04§2.2);选型阈值来自 NN/g 进度指示研究(调研 04§2.2)。
origin.en: Luke Wroblewski's "Avoid The Spinner" established skeletons as the spinner replacement (attention lands on "content is coming", not waiting); M3 lists skeleton loaders among its six transition patterns: a subtle pulse (visually travelling top-left → bottom-right) plus a fast fade-in of content (research 04 §2.2); the selection thresholds come from NN/g's progress-indicator research (research 04 §2.2).

effect.zh: 扫光脉动的周期,CSS 型参数(demo 经 --skeleton-duration 注入)。M3 只要求「微妙脉动」,未记载数值——1200ms 为社区常见值,未证实。
effect.en: Period of the shimmer sweep, a CSS-type param (injected via --skeleton-duration). M3 only requires a "subtle pulse" and records no number — 1200ms is a common community value, unverified.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 切换 data-dir):horizontal=经典左→右扫光,社区最常见形态;diagonal=120° 渐变对角扫过,对应 M3 记载的「微妙脉动,视觉走向从屏幕左上到右下」(调研 04§2.2)。两者只改视觉走向,不改语义。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo toggles data-dir): horizontal = the classic left→right sweep, the community's most common form; diagonal = a 120° gradient crossing the card diagonally, matching M3's documented "subtle pulse, visually travelling from top-left to bottom-right" (research 04 §2.2). Either changes only the visual direction, not the semantics.

note.zh: 纯 CSS 渐变 + transform 动画 + data 属性切换,全浏览器可用,无新特性依赖;不支持时骨架退化为静态色块,语义不受影响。
note.en: Pure CSS gradients, transform animation and data-attribute switching — available everywhere with no modern-feature dependency; without support the skeleton degrades to static blocks, semantics intact.

fallback.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 时停用脉动(色块保持静态基色)、内容切换不做淡入直接呈现;「正在加载」的语义不得只靠动画传达——同时用 aria-busy / 状态文字兜底。
fallback.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion the pulse is disabled (blocks keep their static base color) and content appears without the fade-in; the "loading" semantics must never ride on motion alone — back it with aria-busy / status text.

use.zh: 内容型列表/卡片的首屏加载(Feed、详情页、仪表盘卡片)
use.en: First paint of content lists/cards (feeds, detail pages, dashboard cards)

use.zh: 预期加载 1s 以上且布局已知的页面——先按 NN/g 阈值选型再做骨架
use.en: Pages expected to load over 1s with a known layout — pick via NN/g thresholds first, skeleton second

use.zh: 局部刷新的区块(换页、筛选),保持布局稳定降低跳动
use.en: Locally refreshing regions (pagination, filters) where layout stability matters

avoid.zh: 预期 <1s 的请求——NN/g:用即时状态变化(按压态)即可,骨架反而制造等待感
avoid.en: Requests expected under 1s — NN/g: instant state changes suffice; a skeleton manufactures waiting

avoid.zh: 预期 ≥10s 的长任务——改用百分比进度条 + 文字说明
avoid.en: Long tasks at 10s+ — switch to a percent-done progress bar with descriptive text

avoid.zh: 布局未知的动态内容——占位块与实际内容对不上时,切换瞬间跳动反而更明显
avoid.en: Content whose layout is unknown — mismatched placeholders make the swap-in jump more visible

a11y.zh: 骨架色块是纯装饰,对读屏隐藏;加载状态用 aria-busy 与文字状态(如「正在加载…」)同步传达,不依赖脉动动画;reduced-motion 下停用扫光;内容淡入期间保持布局稳定,避免焦点元素移动。
a11y.en: Skeleton blocks are purely decorative and hidden from screen readers; the loading state is conveyed via aria-busy and status text (e.g. "Loading…"), never via the pulse alone; the sweep is disabled under reduced motion; keep layout stable during the fade so focusable elements do not move.

goal.zh: 复刻一张「骨架 → 内容」的卡片:占位态用色块复刻头像/标题/正文行布局并叠加按快照周期的扫光,内容就绪后以 200ms + M3 Standard easing 快速淡入覆盖,切换零布局跳动。
goal.en: Replicate a skeleton→content card: the placeholder state mirrors the avatar/title/body-line layout with a shimmer at the snapshot period, and the ready content fades in fast at 200ms + M3 Standard easing with zero layout shift.

acceptance.zh: 占位块与内容块尺寸对齐,切换时不发生布局位移
acceptance.en: Placeholder and content blocks align in size; the swap causes no layout shift

acceptance.zh: 扫光只动 transform(translateX),周期取参数快照 --skeleton-duration
acceptance.en: The sweep animates only transform (translateX) at the snapshot period --skeleton-duration

acceptance.zh: 内容淡入 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)(M3 short4 + Standard easing)
acceptance.en: Content fades in at 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) (M3 short4 + Standard easing)

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 时停用扫光与淡入,加载状态用文字/aria-busy 兜底
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, disable the sweep and fade; the loading state rides on text/aria-busy

acceptance.zh: 加载语义同时经 aria-busy 与可见文字传达,不依赖动画
acceptance.en: The loading semantics are conveyed via aria-busy and visible text, never via motion alone
